experiments.name: high-unroll dependency chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 10000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 8; st.w $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, 0; st.w $r4, $r20, 8; li.d $r4, 0' --asm 'fldx.s $f0, $r20, $r4; movfr2gr.s $r4, $f0'

latencies.notes: 3 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 10000, iters 1000. Raw measurement was 3.98; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: fldx.s $f0, $r20, $r4; fldx.s $f1, $r20, $r5; fldx.s $f2, $r20, $r6; fldx.s $f3, $r20, $r7; fldx.s $f4, $r20, $r8; fldx.s $f5, $r20, $r9; fldx.s $f6, $r20, $r10; fldx.s $f7, $r20, $r11
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56' --asm 'fldx.s $f0, $r20, $r4; fldx.s $f1, $r20, $r5; fldx.s $f2, $r20, $r6; fldx.s $f3, $r20, $r7; fldx.s $f4, $r20, $r8; fldx.s $f5, $r20, $r9; fldx.s $f6, $r20, $r10; fldx.s $f7, $r20, $r11'
